hero.title: Pre-purchase vehicle inspection
hero.subtitle: A full inspection or computer diagnostics.

s1.title: Full pre-purchase inspection
s1.text: We travel to the vehicle and assess its condition systematically.
s1.item1: Body, paint depth, and repair traces
s1.item3: OBD diagnostics, electronics, and mileage discrepancies
s1.item4: Test drive, photos, and a clear conclusion

s2.title: Computer diagnostics
s2.text: A focused electronic-systems check when a full vehicle inspection is not required.
s2.item4: A concise explanation of the results

travel.title: Travel fee
travel.text: There is no travel fee in Kaunas or within 20 km of the city boundary. Beyond that area, a €0.50/km round-trip fee may apply; we agree the final price before the visit.

checklist.title: What the full inspection covers
checklist.item8: Signs of mileage or history discrepancies
checklist.item10: A photo report and clear conclusion

cta.title: Have a specific car in mind?
cta.text: Choose a service and an available time online.

step1.title: Book
step1.text: Choose a service, a time, and the vehicle location.

step2.title: We inspect
step2.text: We travel to the car, complete the inspection, and test drive it when possible.

step3.title: Receive the conclusion
step3.text: You receive photos, the findings, and a clear conclusion.
